# graphiant Provider

The Graphiant provider manages Graphiant Network-as-a-Service (NaaS) resources: sites, IAM users and groups, and read-only access to onboarded devices. It is backed by the graphiant-sdk-go client.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    graphiant = {
      source = "Graphiant-Inc/graphiant"
    }
  }
}

# host, access_token, username, and password can all be set via environment
# variables instead (GRAPHIANT_API_HOST, GRAPHIANT_ACCESS_TOKEN,
# GRAPHIANT_USERNAME, GRAPHIANT_PASSWORD) — recommended for anything other
# than a static access_token sourced from a variable, as shown here.
provider "graphiant" {
  host         = "https://api.graphiant.com"
  access_token = var.graphiant_access_token
}

variable "graphiant_access_token" {
  description = "Bearer token issued by the Graphiant portal/CLI."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token issued by the Graphiant portal/CLI. Can also be set via the GRAPHIANT_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable. Takes precedence over username/password.
- `host` (String) Graphiant API base URL. Defaults to https://api.graphiant.com. Can also be set via the GRAPHIANT_API_HOST or GRAPHIANT_HOST environment variables.
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification when calling the Graphiant API. Only use this against a trusted on-prem/lab controller.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Graphiant password, used to log in when access_token is not set. Can also be set via the GRAPHIANT_PASSWORD environment variable.
- `username` (String) Graphiant username, used to log in when access_token is not set. Can also be set via the GRAPHIANT_USERNAME environment variable.
